description: Keyboard and mouse from GateLab's HDMI Input panel (or Claude's hid_input) over the board's UART: USB HID key codes with press and release, relative and absolute mouse, wheel and an all-up event. Resynchronises on the next packet after a lost byte.

de.description: Tastatur und Maus aus GateLabs HDMI-Eingang (oder Claudes hid_input) über den UART des Boards: USB-HID-Tastencodes mit Drücken und Loslassen, relative und absolute Maus, Mausrad und ein Alles-los-Ereignis. Findet nach einem verlorenen Byte mit dem nächsten Paket wieder Tritt.
de.name: Tastatur und Maus über seriell

name: Keyboard and mouse over serial

parameters.description: Bits per second (the Serial Monitor's setting)
parameters.name: BAUD

ports.description: Serial input from the board's USB serial port (8N1), idles high
ports.name: rx

ports.description: One-cycle pulse: a key went down or up
ports.name: key_valid

ports.description: The key's USB HID usage (page 7; E0–E7 are Control, Shift, Option, Command left and right)
ports.name: key_usage

ports.description: One-cycle pulse: an absolute pointer position arrived
ports.name: position_valid

ports.description: Pointer column in the picture's pixels
ports.name: position_x

ports.description: Pointer row in the picture's pixels
ports.name: position_y

ports.description: Mouse buttons held (bit 0 left, 1 right, 2 middle), from the last move or position
ports.name: buttons

ports.description: One-cycle pulse: every key and button was released (capture ended)
ports.name: all_up
